theorem: general even-k factorization (verified at k=6, N=23, K=11, m=2, exact match 27756.8219)
statement: For every s >= 1: A_{2s,S}(q) = sum_{i,j in S}|J|^2s = m^2 * Sigma_{2s}(q), where Sigma_{2s} sums e_N(q[sum_r (x_r - y_r)]) over 2s-tuples with prod x_r / prod y_r in H AND prod(x_r-1)/prod(y_r-1) in H. The variety V_{2s} is (2s-2)-dimensional.
structure: The y-tuple map (y_r) -> (prody, prod(y_r-1)) has fibers of size ~N^{2s-2}/K^2 (at N=23, s=3: 9261 tuples -> 484 keys, fiber ~19); the constrained sum groups by these keys, so Sigma_{2s} is a bilinear sum between the x-fiber counts and the y-fiber counts — a symmetric bilinear form on the (key1,key2) count table. The Katz sheaf is the SAME for all s (the two product constraints); only the symmetric power grows.
status: [PROVEN] at k=6, N=23 (one point); template general
